# Repository Labels

## Issue Labels

| Label              | Colour      | Description                              |
|--------------------|-------------|------------------------------------------|
| `bug`              | `#d73a4a`   | Something is not working                 |
| `enhancement`      | `#a2eeef`   | New feature or request                   |
| `documentation`    | `#0075ca`   | Documentation only                       |
| `question`         | `#d876e3`   | Further information is requested         |
| `help wanted`      | `#008672`   | Extra attention is needed                |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff`   | Good for newcomers                       |

## Area Labels

| Label              | Colour      | Description                              |
|--------------------|-------------|------------------------------------------|
| `area:runtime`     | `#bfdadc`   | Runtime lifecycle / state machine        |
| `area:database`    | `#c5def5`   | Database models / migrations             |
| `area:storage`     | `#d4c5f9`   | File operations / atomic writes          |
| `area:deployment`  | `#f9d0c4`   | Packaging / portable / installed         |
| `area:diagnostics` | `#fef3c0`   | Environment checks / validation          |
| `area:security`    | `#f9c0c0`   | Security / signing / audit               |
| `area:gui`         | `#c0f9d3`   | Desktop user interface                   |
| `area:pdf`         | `#c0f0f9`   | PDF generation                            |
| `area:ai`          | `#e8c0f9`   | AI assistant                             |
| `area:tests`       | `#c0e8f9`   | Test infrastructure                      |

## Process Labels

| Label              | Colour      | Description                              |
|--------------------|-------------|------------------------------------------|
| `status:blocked`   | `#b60205`   | Blocked by another issue or dependency   |
| `status:duplicate` | `#cfd3d7`   | Already reported / requested             |
| `status:invalid`   | `#e4e669`   | Not reproducible or not a bug            |
| `status:wontfix`   | `#ffffff`   | Decision not to address                  |
| `priority:high`    | `#d73a4a`   | High priority                            |
| `priority:medium`  | `#fbca04`   | Medium priority (default)                |
| `priority:low`     | `#0e8a16`   | Low priority                             |

## Pull Request Labels

| Label              | Colour      | Description                              |
|--------------------|-------------|------------------------------------------|
| `needs-review`     | `#fbca04`   | Awaiting code review                     |
| `changes-requested`| `#d73a4a`   | Changes requested by reviewer            |
| `approved`         | `#0e8a16`   | Changes approved for merge               |
| `do-not-merge`     | `#b60205`   | Temporary hold                           |
